headword: {一泊二食付|いっぱくにしょくつ}き
reading: いっぱくにしょくつき
gloss: one night with two meals (lodging plan)

definitions.gloss: one night's stay including dinner and breakfast
definitions.explanation: The standard accommodation plan at a Japanese {旅館|りょかん} or resort hotel: one night's lodging with the evening meal and the following morning's breakfast included in the price. The two meals are dinner and breakfast, in that order, not lunch.

examples.japanese: {一泊二食付|いっぱくにしょくつ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I booked one night with two meals included.

examples.japanese: {一泊二食付|いっぱくにしょくつ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{一万五千円|いちまんごせんえん}です。
examples.english: It's fifteen thousand yen for one night with two meals.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一泊二食付|いっぱくにしょくつ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧しか⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This inn only offers plans that include one night and two meals.

examples.japanese: {温泉宿|おんせんやど}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一泊二食付|いっぱくにしょくつ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{夕食|ゆうしょく}→夕食：03006_yuushoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|だ}される→出す：01087_dasu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: At hot-spring inns the standard is one night with two meals, and dinner is often served in your room.

notes:
Reading trap: ⟦{一泊|いっぱく}→一泊：08892_ippaku⟧ and {二食|にしょく} both take sound changes, and ⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧ here is the suffix meaning 'included', not ふ. The phrase is booking-site vocabulary — you will meet it on every Japanese lodging site, usually as a plan name.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一泊二食付|いっぱくにしょくつ}き⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧: a one-night, two-meal plan
- {一泊二食付|いっぱくにしょくつ}きで〜⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧: ~yen for one night with two meals

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{素泊|すど}まり→素泊まり：07048_sudomari⟧: room only — lodging with no meals at all
- {一泊朝食付|いっぱくちょうしょくつ}き: one night with breakfast — the usual business-hotel plan
- ⟦{二泊|にはく}→二泊：30783_nihaku⟧: a two-night stay
